title: Principal PMT - International, Prime Video Personalization & Discovery
desc:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads. 
Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.
As a Prime Video Tech PM, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people. 
We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!
We are looking for an experienced Principal Product Manager Tech to own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for personalized content discovery for various international markets. You will operate at the intersection of machine learning, customer experience, and business strategy, leading fast-paced, high-impact projects and partnering with experts in data science, ML engineering, and customer experience to ship ML-powered features at scale.
Qualifications:
* The ideal candidate would have demonstrably thrived in a high growth environment and delivered broadly adopted technology products or services
* They would be a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and compellingly with stakeholders, partners and leaders, and understand how to drive a high level of focus and excellence
* They would have keen business sense together with a deep understanding of technology
* They would have experience defining products, mapping requirements to engineering functional specifications, leading large cross functional and cross organizational efforts, and delivering at high scale
* 10+ years of technical Product Management experience, or 7+ years of PM experience and 3+ years of Engg experience.
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
This role is ideal for a PM with deep experience in the intersection of Personalization and Media Streaming experiences, who anchors every decision in customer value and measurable business outcomes. You will formulate the product and science vision for your domain, translate ambiguous customer and business problems into clear algorithmic objectives and technical requirements, and guide sound science decisions throughout the ML lifecycle—from problem framing and data strategy through experimentation, deployment, and ongoing optimization. Throughout, you’ll ensure that complex algorithmic capabilities become intuitive, high-quality customer experiences.
Key job responsibilities
* Own the roadmap and strategy for personalization products for INTL territories, including recommendation systems and ML/science-based models.
* Collaborate with business leaders, other PMs and Applied Scientists to translate business problems into model requirements and convert them into clear algorithmic objectives, metrics, and guardrails.
* Define, track, and analyze key metrics to measure recommendation quality, customer outcomes, and business impact; analyze user behavior data to identify opportunities to improve personalization.
* Lead A/B testing strategy and experimentation to validate algorithmic improvements and inform roadmap decisions.
* Partner with stakeholder teams to understand business needs and translate them into technical specifications and prioritized work.
* Communicate complex technical and algorithmic concepts clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
* Balance trade-offs between model complexity, latency, scalability, and business value to ensure robust, production-ready solutions.
Basic Qualifications
* 10+ years of technical product management or 7+ years of PM and 3+ years of Eng experience.
* 6+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Bachelor's degree, Masters Preferred
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience managing consumer-facing products where ML directly impacts user experience and engagement.
* Experience leading science and technology discussions and influencing strategy for ML- or science-driven products.
* Background in an applied science, engineering, or quantitative field, with a solid understanding of the model lifecycle, data readiness, and model evaluation frameworks.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience in content discovery, e-commerce, search, or recommendation systems 
* Knowledge of modern ML techniques (deep learning, NLP, LLM, Agentic AIs) and their practical trade-offs.
* Strong leadership skills with ability to influence cross-functional teams 
* Experience working with senior-level stakeholders 
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
 Basic qualifications: - 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- 6+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience

title: Software Development Engineer, AI Business Automation, AI Business Automation, Prime Video
desc:
Prime Video is changing the way people watch movies, TV shows, and live sports, offering a vast library of content to a global audience. We are constantly innovating to enhance the customer experience, from how content is discovered and consumed to how we produce and deliver it at scale. Our mission is to be the premier entertainment destination, and we achieve this through a relentless focus on the customer, a passion for storytelling, and a commitment to technical excellence. 
We are forming a new organization within Prime Video to redefine our operational landscape through the power of artificial intelligence. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will play a key role in building the next generation of business automation. You will collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and scientists to design, develop, and deploy the agentic AI solutions that will power this transformation. This is an opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a new initiative, work with complex distributed systems, and see your contributions directly improve how Prime Video operates for our customers worldwide. 
Key Job Responsibilities 
Design, implement, and deploy high-quality, scalable, and reliable services for our automation platform. 
Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, and applied scientists to deliver on our product roadmap and solve customer problems. 
Utilize your problem-solving skills to tackle technical challenges in a large-scale distributed environment. 
Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, and operational support, while adhering to engineering best practices. 
Work backwards from business needs to build features and systems that directly impact our internal customers and improve efficiency. 
This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of one of Amazon's most exciting businesses through the application of AI technologies. If you're passionate about leveraging AI to drive real-world impact at massive scale, we want to hear from you. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 3+ years of building large-scale machine learning and AI solutions at Internet scale experience

title: Creative Director, Creative Director, Prime Video AVOD
desc:
The Creative Director will be responsible for shaping the creative vision, strategy, and execution of entertainment marketing campaigns across Amazon MX Player. This role combines original creative thinking, exceptional craftsmanship, team leadership, and operational agility to deliver compelling, audience-first campaigns across multiple formats and platforms.
Key responsibilities include:
Lead creative strategy, conceptualisation, and execution of integrated marketing campaigns for films and series.
Develop breakthrough ideas across key art, trailers, promos, digital, social, and audiovisual formats.
Establish and maintain high creative standards across storytelling, art direction, copywriting, design, and editing.
Manage, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary creative teams, building stronger creative judgment and independent campaign ownership.
Partner with marketing, content, production, and business stakeholders to translate insights into effective creative solutions.
Provide hands-on creative direction from initial briefing through final execution and quality control.
Drive innovation through emerging technologies, generative AI, and efficient creative production workflows.
Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets, scalability, and business priorities.
Build a creatively self-sufficient in-house team while reducing dependency on external agencies.
Champion a culture of experimentation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Success will be measured by creative originality, campaign effectiveness, craftsmanship, team development, and the ability to consistently deliver outstanding entertainment marketing at scale.
Key job responsibilities
We are looking for a Creative Director to lead the development and execution of high-impact, culturally relevant marketing campaigns for Amazon MX Player. This role requires a creative leader with exceptional storytelling abilities, strong visual craft, and a deep understanding of entertainment, digital culture, and audience behaviour.
The Creative Director will drive original campaign thinking across key art, trailers, promos, social media, and integrated marketing initiatives. They will translate business objectives and consumer insights into compelling creative ideas while maintaining exceptional standards of conceptualisation, design, copywriting, and audiovisual storytelling.
The role involves leading and mentoring a multidisciplinary team of art directors, copywriters, designers, and editors, fostering creative ownership, innovation, and operational excellence. The candidate must collaborate effectively with marketing, content, production, and external partners to deliver distinctive campaigns at speed and scale.
We seek someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on creative expertise, embraces emerging technologies and AI-powered workflows, and consistently raises the creative benchmark.
The ideal candidate has 10+ years of relevant experience, a strong portfolio of integrated campaigns, and proven creative leadership capabilities. Above all, they must be an original thinker who can inspire teams, challenge conventions, and transform ambitious ideas into memorable audience experiences.
A day in the life
As a Creative Director at Amazon MX Player, you will lead the creative vision and execution of high-impact entertainment marketing campaigns, transforming compelling stories into culturally relevant, audience-first creative experiences.
Your day will involve collaborating with marketing, content, and production teams to understand business priorities, audience insights, and campaign objectives. You will lead creative brainstorms, develop original campaign territories, and guide teams across key art, trailers, promos, social media, and integrated marketing assets.
You will work closely with art directors, copywriters, designers, and editors, providing hands-on creative direction and constructive feedback to elevate storytelling, visual craft, and overall campaign quality.
Beyond conceptualisation, you will review creative work, solve execution challenges, manage multiple campaign timelines, and collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure seamless delivery.
You will champion innovation by exploring emerging creative technologies, AI-powered workflows, and new storytelling formats that improve both creative excellence and operational efficiency.
Most importantly, you will inspire and mentor a multidisciplinary team, encouraging original thinking, creative ownership, and a culture of continuous improvement.
This is a role for someone who thrives on turning bold ideas into breakthrough campaigns while balancing creativity, speed, scale, and business impact. Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of marketing, brand advertising, media sales or online advertising work and close work with senior advertisers and agency stakeholders experience Preferred qualifications: - Preferred someone who has an experience in digital or broadcast media or advertising handling large scale tentpole campaigns for brands or series/movies.

title: Content Acquisition Manager - Prime Videos, Amazon Prime Video
desc:
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
 Amazon.in is seeking an experienced, dynamic, data-driven content acquisition professional to lead English entertainment content acquisition for Prime Video India. The role will have responsibility for creating, managing and expanding our content provider network and relationships. The individual in this role will be responsible for deep diving into the English entertainment market segment, identifying and closing deals, slates and titles that fit into the overall service programming for the category, and planning content selection for the forward looking 12+ months. This role will also involve negotiating license agreements and securing great content selection for Amazon (Prime Video). It's a mix of strategy and execution.
Key job responsibilities
Create Amazon's English entertainment content strategy driven by data analysis, customer preferences and market dynamics.
Identify content opportunities and partnerships with studios, independent producers and content owners/aggregators.
Negotiate license agreements in line with Amazon's guardrails with content providers to secure high demand content for the service. Benchmark content and create a category level strategy / execution plan to meet service level goals. Build and manage relationships with CEOs/ heads of studios/ Licensing Teams at all key studios.
Focus on understanding customer needs, pain points, behaviors and preferences; seek feedback and invent new delightful experiences on their behalf.
Work closely with colleagues in other departments and locations to build and grow the category.
Analyze the market segment conditions, challenges and opportunities.
Dive deep and analyze customer viewership data, focus groups, online surveys, in-person interviews, external benchmarking and other forms of secondary research. Analyse metrics/results to drive improvements in acquisition strategy.
Develop and document acquisition plans, financial metrics and goals for leadership.
Work with other teams to present content to our customers; be the strongest internal voice of our customers.
Drive continuous improvement in all operational aspects of Amazon's relationship with its content suppliers. Basic qualifications: - Experience in an account management, licensing or business development role
- 10+ years of content licensing, syndication or distribution experience. Preferred qualifications: - Experience in movies & TV distribution/licensing
- Experience in managing licensing and acquisition for English entertainment.

title: PR Specialist, Amazon Prime Video, India
desc:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+ and HBO. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.
We are looking for an experienced entertainment public relations professional to execute publicity campaigns for Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios content in India. Based in Mumbai and reporting to the Head of Communications for Prime Video India, you will be responsible for driving earned media coverage and conversation around our growing slate of Original, Exclusive, and licensed content.
The successful candidate will execute communications campaigns across our content portfolio — including Original series, films, unscripted programming, and live sports — working closely with internal stakeholders, international PR colleagues, and external agency partners to deliver impactful publicity in the India market. You will write compelling materials, manage media relationships, and support the planning and delivery of publicity events including premieres, press junkets, and talent-led moments.
To succeed in this role, you must have high judgment, strong writing skills, and the ability to execute with speed and precision under tight deadlines. You must think clearly, communicate concisely, and manage multiple workstreams without losing attention to detail. You will be expected to stay deeply plugged into India's entertainment and media landscape — understanding what stories resonate, which journalists to engage, and how to generate meaningful coverage. The successful candidate will be prepared to roll up their sleeves and get work done, even when at times it sits outside the scope of the role's direct remit.
Come build the future of entertainment with us.
Key job responsibilities
Content Publicity
- Execute PR campaigns for locally produced Amazon Originals, licensed content, select global Original and Exclusive series, and the broader content slate
- Draft press materials including releases, media alerts, talking points, Q&As, and briefing documents
- Pitch stories proactively to news and digital media to secure high-impact coverage
Events & Talent Publicity
- Support the planning and execution of premieres, junkets, set visits, talent interviews, and other tactics
- Coordinate with talent teams, production partners, and talent representatives to deliver media-facing events
- Manage on-ground logistics and media coordination
Media Relations
- Build and maintain strong working relationships with relevant journalists 
- Conduct proactive and reactive media relations, managing inbound inquiries in coordination with the Head of Communications
- Monitor media coverage and entertainment industry trends; identify opportunities for PV to be part of cultural conversations
Cross-Functional & International Collaboration
- Collaborate with international teams and Amazon MGM Studios to support global campaigns with India strategies
- Work with internal stakeholders (content, marketing, social media) to ensure campaign delivery
- Manage day-to-day relationships with PR agency partners, ensuring quality and timely execution
Measurement & Reporting
- Track campaign performance, coverage, and share of voice
- Provide post-campaign analysis with clear learnings and recommendations for future improvement Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Bachelor's degree in communications, public relations, or a related field
- Experience in media relations and issues management
- Experience managing external agencies
- 5–7 years of professional public relations experience with a focus on the entertainment industry (studio, streamer, network, production house, or entertainment PR agency)
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi
- Experience writing press materials (press releases, media kits, talking points, briefing documents)
- Existing working relationships with entertainment and lifestyle media in India Preferred qualifications: - Experience in crisis management and response or equivalent
- Post-graduate degree or diploma in Communications, PR, or Journalism
- Track record of executing creative publicity campaigns and entertainment events
- Experience working with talent, talent representatives, and publicists
- Experience working with international teams across multiple time zones
- Fluency in one or more additional regional Indian languages beyond Hindi and English

title: Software Development Engineer, Prime Video Experience Tech
desc:
Are you eager to shape the future of video entertainment, from movies and TV shows to live sports events? Do you enjoy tackling complex challenges within large-scale systems? If so, we invite you to help build the future of entertainment with us at Prime Video!
Since its launch in 2007, Prime Video has been transforming the traditional television and movie industry. With a rapidly expanding library of high-quality content and availability in over 240 countries and territories, Prime Video is now a key strategic priority for Amazon. We invest heavily in acquiring, producing, and programming a diverse range of TV shows, movies, and live events. Our exclusive titles include "The Lord of the Rings," "The Boys," "The Wheel of Time," and "The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel," among others. Beyond our extensive On-Demand catalog, Prime Video offers a wide selection of Linear Channels and Live Sports, featuring major events like Thursday Night Football, the English Premier League, NBA, MLB, ATP tennis, French Open, and the UEFA Champions League. If this sparks your interest, read on!
Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain highly scalable systems that power Prime Video’s streaming services.
- Define the architecture for our software, utilizing a broad range of technologies, programming languages, and systems.
- Implement and operate APIs that manage billions of playback start requests, ensuring seamless, low-latency content delivery.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to influence the overall technical strategy and contribute to the team’s long-term roadmap.
- Communicate effectively across teams and stakeholders, ensuring alignment with technical goals and project timelines.
- Apply creative problem-solving skills to address complex challenges.
- Stay ahead of industry trends and new technologies, integrating them where appropriate. Fluency in GenAI based developer efficiency tools is a plus. 
- Mentor and guide other engineers, contributing to the overall growth and success of the engineering team.
A day in the life
As a software engineer on the Prime Video team, my day starts with diving into hands-on coding and technical problem-solving. I’m not just writing code—I’m helping to shape the architecture of complex systems that millions of people rely on every day. One of the most rewarding aspects of my role is seeing my work come to life when friends and family use Prime Video to watch their favorite shows and live sports.
My primary focus is on designing and maintaining the APIs that power every title on Prime Video. This involves creating highly reliable and low-latency systems that ensure users can start streaming their content with just a click. The challenges are unique, especially when it comes to managing the sheer scale of requests we handle daily. To tackle these, I leverage AWS technologies like EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Kinesis, and CloudFront.
Collaboration is a significant aspect of my role. I collaborate with a cross-functional team to align our technical strategies and define our long-term roadmap. It’s exhilarating to influence decisions that will shape the future of Prime Video. Throughout the day, I alternate between deep focus on coding and brainstorming sessions with my teammates to tackle novel challenges.
Beyond the technical work, I also play a key role in mentoring junior engineers. Sharing my knowledge and seeing others grow is incredibly fulfilling. I’m always encouraged to push the boundaries of what’s possible, and I have the freedom to explore new ideas that can elevate our service to the next level.
At the end of the day, I know that the work I do directly contributes to a world-class viewing experience for millions of Prime Video users, and that’s a great feeling.
 Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
